name: Impact: Hit Sounds
author: wolfsdk
description: Two decls for impacts. The family node inheritences/impacts (45 descendants) now lets four impacts sound at the same time instead of two -- in the original a burst drops the rest -- and raises the lower bound of the random volume from -6 to -3 dB without giving up the spread. On top of that, imp_flesh (the body hit, pulled in by 15 files) gets its own volume.offset of 4 dB so flesh stands out from concrete and metal. No number above 4 dB, no new audio file. Not confirmed in game: that changed sound decls take effect is inferred from the archive structure (same entry remainder as entityDef/weapon, no .bin counterpart like for particle), not observed. No audio file is touched; streamed.resources and english.streamed stay untouched.
